cmd: tc filter add dev dummy1 parent ffff: handle 0x1 prio 1 protocol all matchall skip_hw action reclassify
desc: positive: Add ingress matchall filter for all protocols and action RECLASSIFY with skip_hw flag

match.pattern: (?sm)^filter parent ffff: protocol all pref 1 matchall.*handle 0x1.*skip_hw.*not_in_hw.*gact action reclassify.*ref 1 bind 1

pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 ingress

readback.cmd: tc filter get dev dummy1 parent ffff: handle 0x1 prio 1 protocol all matchall
readback.name: verify
